power.name: Power & Life Support
power.work: Reads a handheld diagnostic meter and moves its probe with a controlled wrist motion.

comms.name: Comms & Navigation
comms.work: Listens on headset, checks the tablet and gives a short acknowledgement.

science.name: Science
science.work: Raises a sealed sample for inspection while keeping the support hand steady.

launch.name: Launch & Budget
launch.work: Holds a checklist tablet and tracks an item with the right hand.

crew.name: Ayesha

appearance.hair: charcoal low bun with grey strands
appearance.detail: calm eyes and a measured half-smile

crew.personality: Patient, observant and methodical. Notices small problems before they become emergencies.
crew.signature: Cuff inspection: checks her wrist seal, then gives one quiet nod.

crew.name: Maya

appearance.detail: direct eyes and firm relaxed mouth

crew.personality: Composed, decisive and economical with gestures. Reassures others through a steady presence.
crew.signature: Team check: a small open-palm acknowledgement followed by a settled stance.

crew.name: Bilal

appearance.detail: clean shaven, compact earpiece and eager expression

crew.personality: Curious and diligent, with a little nervous energy. Double-checks a signal before speaking.
crew.signature: Headset adjustment: listens, checks a small readout and settles his shoulders.

crew.name: Lin
crew.personality: Precise, attentive and unflustered. Gives clear directions and waits for acknowledgement.
crew.signature: Readback: touches the headset, pauses to listen, then gives a concise confirmation.

crew.name: Dr. Sana

appearance.detail: round glasses and curious attentive eyes

crew.personality: Reflective and inquisitive. Pauses to compare evidence before deciding what it means.
crew.signature: Observation: adjusts her glasses, tilts her head and notes one detail.

crew.name: Kofi

appearance.detail: short neat beard and warm small smile

crew.personality: Hands-on, calm and encouraging. Handles equipment carefully and is quick to share a useful finding.
crew.signature: Sample check: raises a labelled-by-code sample container for inspection, then lowers it safely.

crew.name: Omar

appearance.hair: grey temples and short grey beard
appearance.detail: cautious kind eyes and a measured expression

crew.personality: Grounded and conscientious. Prefers one deliberate check to a hurried assumption.
crew.signature: Checklist: follows the entries with a finger, then checks the next item.

crew.name: Zara

appearance.detail: alert eyes and confident small smile

crew.personality: Energetic, inclusive and focused. Connects a plan to the next concrete action.
crew.signature: Briefing: checks the plan, indicates the next station and gives a confident nod.
